summary.name: Tongyi (通义)
summary.one_liner: Tongyi is Alibaba's AI model platform from Tongyi Lab, offering the Qwen (千问) large language models and Wan (万相) visual generation models for businesses and developers.
use_cases: build business AI applications with large language models
generate videos and images from text or reference images
summarize long documents and meeting notes
detect fraud and sensitive content on platforms
power conversational robots in consumer devices
summary.what_it_does: The page is a marketing landing page for Alibaba's Tongyi Lab, listing its Qwen (千问) language and multimodal models such as Qwen3-Max, Qwen-Plus, Qwen-Flash, Qwen3-Coder-Plus, Qwen3-VL-Plus, Qwen3-Omni-Flash and Qwen-Image. It also lists Wan (万相) visual generation models, including Wan2.6 text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video and text-to-image variants, and Wan2.2-Animate for video character replacement and image-driven motion. Industry solution sections cover consumer electronics, companionship robots, in-car assistants, document and text analysis, content safety review, device risk control and anti-fraud. The page does not describe an outbound calling product specifically, and no pricing details are shown.
notable: Qwen (千问) family of large language and multimodal models
Wan (万相) video and image generation models with native multimodal framework
Industry solution suites for consumer devices, in-car, content safety and anti-fraud
Text analysis tools such as long document summarization and entity extraction
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; no pricing or free-tier details are stated
Outbound calling/dialogue robot product mentioned in the listing is not described on this page
